verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a code-hosting platform like GitHub, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents installing, configuring, upgrading, or maintaining a GitHub instance on your own infrastructure. The pack covers cloud features (Codespaces, Copilot cloud agent, Actions), and the only self-hosting-adjacent mentions (docs versions selectable by plan, a community wish for self-hosted runners) are adjacent features that do not deliver this capability.
